# Testing

This file lists verification commands for the Angular SPA at the repository root and for the RealWorld conformance pack under `realworld/`. Commands come from [package.json](package.json) and CI workflows unless noted. No command in this file was executed as part of harness preparation; each entry is **documented**.

For agent entry points and the component map, see [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). For E2E gating with `TEST_MODE`, `BROWSER_API`, and `EXTERNAL_API`, see [GUIDELINES.md](GUIDELINES.md). Active and proposed git hooks that run checks are in [HOOKS.md](HOOKS.md).

---

## Quick reference

| Command | Purpose | Source | Status |
|--------|---------|--------|--------|
| `bun run test` | Vitest unit tests (colocated under `src/app`) | [package.json](package.json) | documented |
| `bun run test:coverage` | Vitest with coverage | [package.json](package.json) | documented |
| `bun run test:ui` | Vitest UI mode | [package.json](package.json) | documented |
| `bun run test:e2e` | Playwright E2E, excludes `@security` | [package.json](package.json), [.github/workflows/playwright.yml](.github/workflows/playwright.yml) | documented |
| `bun run test:e2e:security` | Playwright specs tagged `@security` | [package.json](package.json), [.github/workflows/security-tests.yml](.github/workflows/security-tests.yml) | documented |
| `bun run build` | Production Angular build | [package.json](package.json) | documented |
| `bun run format:check` | Prettier check (ts, html, css, json, md) | [package.json](package.json) | documented |

Run `bun run setup` before first use when the project README documents it (inferred from skill prerequisites).

## Unit tests (Vitest)

Angular service and feature tests live next to implementation code under `src/app`. CI workflows in the supplied evidence run E2E and build; Vitest at the root is primarily a local and hook workflow (inferred from automation notes).

**Workflow:** [skills/run-vitest-unit-tests/SKILL.md](skills/run-vitest-unit-tests/SKILL.md)

**Typical commands:**

- `bun run test` — default run
- `bun run test:coverage` — coverage report
- `bun run test:ui` — interactive UI

Implementation-focused guidance: [src/app/AGENTS.md](src/app/AGENTS.md).

## End-to-end tests (Playwright)

The shared suite lives under `realworld/specs/e2e/`. Root `playwright.config.ts` points at that tree and extends defaults from `realworld/specs/e2e/playwright.base.ts` (documented in [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md)). The SPA under `src/app` is the system under test when you run root `test:e2e` scripts.

**Non-security suite (default CI E2E):**

1. Start the dev server (command wired in `playwright.config.ts` / `playwright.base.ts`; commonly `npm run start` or `bun run start` with `baseURL` such as `http://localhost:3000`).
2. `bun run test:e2e` — runs Playwright with `--grep-invert @security` per [package.json](package.json).

**Skill:** [skills/run-playwright-e2e-tests/SKILL.md](skills/run-playwright-e2e-tests/SKILL.md)  
**CI:** [.github/workflows/playwright.yml](.github/workflows/playwright.yml)

**Security-only suite:**

- `bun run test:e2e:security` — runs specs tagged `@security` (for example XSS scenarios).

**Skill:** [skills/run-playwright-security-e2e-tests/SKILL.md](skills/run-playwright-security-e2e-tests/SKILL.md)  
**CI:** [.github/workflows/security-tests.yml](.github/workflows/security-tests.yml)

### UI and route contract (do not duplicate here)

Implementations must match the canonical selector, route, `localStorage` (`jwtToken`), and debug surface defined in [realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md](realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md). REST and SPA contracts are indexed in [CONTRACTS.md](CONTRACTS.md). Domain vocabulary for scenarios is in [DOMAIN.md](DOMAIN.md).

### Extending E2E coverage

- New or extended domain specs (articles, auth, comments): [skills/add-e2e-domain-spec/SKILL.md](skills/add-e2e-domain-spec/SKILL.md)
- SPA client HTTP behavior via `page.route()` (for example 2xx DELETE handling): [skills/add-spa-route-mock-test/SKILL.md](skills/add-spa-route-mock-test/SKILL.md)

Conformance pack layout and helpers: [realworld/AGENTS.md](realworld/AGENTS.md).

## Production build

`bun run build` runs the production Angular build from [package.json](package.json). Use it after substantive frontend changes and before release-oriented work. Deploy workflows may invoke the same script (inferred from analysis references to deploy).

## Suggested check order (local)

1. `bun run format:check` — fast style gate (also relevant to [HOOKS.md](HOOKS.md) proposed hooks).
2. `bun run test` — unit tests.
3. `bun run build` — compile gate.
4. With the app running: `bun run test:e2e`, then `bun run test:e2e:security` when security specs matter.

For backend or full-stack setups that use `EXTERNAL_API`, follow [GUIDELINES.md](GUIDELINES.md) before interpreting skipped or failing specs.
